verdict.rationale: v0's evidence shows AI-assisted code generation, GitHub integration, one-click deploys, and an API for programmatic use, but nothing describes user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background (e.g., scheduled tasks, triggers, or unattended workflows). Auto-fix features (v0-docs-9, v0-docs-20) are reactive to user-initiated deploy failures, not standalone background automations.
